policy: Curated summaries written by CORE with links to official sources. No copied third-party text beyond short factual metadata; no indiscriminate scraping. Agents read only approved documents. Updates require human approval.

documents.title: Street-Use Permits (b6tj-gt35)
documents.text: Public Works street-space permits including excavation, street improvement, boring and emergency permits. Each record has a permit number, type, status, CNN location, holder organisation and authorized start/end dates. A permit authorizes a window; it does not prove that work happened.
documents.limitations: Administrative record; contact columns removed by CORE.

documents.title: CORE coordination method (Phase 2C/2D)
documents.text: Deterministic scheduling under declared constraints: ±30 days shift, 7 days notice, programme permits over 90 days fixed, durations preserved. Overlap between organisations is reported as neutral. Recommendations require dominance or verified overlaps; a gateway recomputes everything.
documents.limitations: Not municipal rules; no traffic or cost model.

documents.title: Street Tree Inventory (tkzw-k3nq)
documents.text: Public Works asset inventory of street trees with species, legal status, site, planting date, diameter class, CNN and coordinates. The dataset was migrated to a new asset system in December 2024 and corrected in 2026.
documents.limitations: Planting dates often missing; presence not verified.

documents.title: Street Tree Removal Notifications (qrwx-q4gg)
documents.text: 24-hour, 15-day or 30-day public notices posted on trees after a removal permit. A notice does not confirm that the tree was removed.

documents.title: Tree proximity indicator (tree-proximity-exposure-v1)
documents.text: Counts inventoried trees within a radius of the published permit point. Permit points are geocoded to the address or segment, not the trench alignment, so distances are indicative and results are sensitive to the radius.
documents.limitations: Not a damage or ecological model.

documents.title: Building Permits (i98e-djp9)
documents.text: Department of Building Inspection permits with type, status, filed, issued and completed dates, address, block/lot and description. Since December 2024 only new or updated rows are published.
documents.limitations: Free-text descriptions; statuses may stay open.

documents.title: Observation: DBI 'issued' status is not a reliable activity signal
documents.text: In the 2026-10-13 snapshot, 540 of 669 building permits with status 'issued' near the Folsom/Howard corridor were issued more than three years earlier without a completion date. CORE therefore uses a recency window to treat a permit as current.

documents.title: Existing Buildings Energy Performance Ordinance Report (96ck-qcfe)
documents.text: Annual benchmarks reported by owners of non-residential buildings of at least 10,000 sq ft and residential buildings of at least 50,000 sq ft (Environment Code Chapter 20), via Energy Star Portfolio Manager: site and source EUI, GHG, Energy Star score, compliance status.
documents.limitations: Not metered by CORE; no savings model.

documents.title: Sidewalk Widths (4g86-grxu)
documents.text: Sidewalk presence and widths from a 2014 AECOM study joined to centerlines, with minimum and recommended widths by street class.
documents.limitations: May not reflect later streetscape projects.

documents.title: USGS real-time earthquake feeds
documents.text: GeoJSON feeds of recent earthquakes with magnitude, place, time, coordinates, review status (automatic or reviewed). Automatic solutions can be revised.
documents.limitations: Location and magnitude uncertainty; no impact assessment.

documents.title: Limitation: no structural or subsurface data
documents.text: CORE has no structural, soil or liquefaction data for corridor assets. It can list assets near an event but cannot assess damage.

documents.title: NWS active alerts API
documents.text: Active watches, warnings and advisories by forecast zone (San Francisco: CAZ006). Alerts are forecasts and warnings, not observations.

documents.title: Board of Supervisors legislative records
documents.text: Legislative matters with file number, type (ordinance, resolution, hearing…), status, body and dates. CORE stores metadata only and classifies items as proposals or approved decisions from the official status, without evaluating positions or actors.

documents.title: Civic neutrality policy
documents.text: Political and civic items are attributed to their official source, classified only by type and status, never ranked or used to persuade. Sponsors and officials are not scored.

documents.title: Knowledge graph relationship bases
documents.text: Relationships are observed, derived, rule-based or hypotheses, each with a reason. AFFECTS is hypothesis-only; proximity never implies causality.

documents.title: Provenance and verification rules
documents.text: Snapshots carry request URLs, retrieval times and SHA-256 checksums verified in Node and in the browser. Reported claims from feeds remain 'reported' until corroborated by an official record.

documents.title: Golden Gate Bridge main span
documents.text: Published main span between towers: 1,280 m (4,200 ft).

documents.title: OSM-measured Golden Gate tower spacing
documents.text: Distance between the OSM south and north tower centroids measured by CORE: 1,283.0 m.
